title: WorldView-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Global Cultural Perspectives in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating free-form generative responses to culturally significant, open-ended questions using an LLM-based pipeline. The methodology includes extracting cultural references to calculate a Perspectives Distribution Score (PDS) and entropy for assessing representational balance, and conducting zero-shot sentiment analysis to assess the model's stance (positive, neutral, negative) toward eight distinct global cultures (Western, Eastern, Islamic, South Asian, Latin American, African, Indigenous, and Others).
